items.question: What is a Company Store?
items.answer: A Company Store is a centralized online storefront where approved employees, teams, departments, locations, and customers order branded merchandise, apparel, promotional products, and marketing materials from one pre-approved catalog. Blossom Rocket Company Stores are powered through SplashBrands, with no order minimums, no inventory to buy or hold, and orders typically shipping in 2 to 5 days.

items.question: Why do businesses use Company Stores?
items.answer: Businesses use Company Stores to centralize merchandise management, improve brand consistency, simplify purchasing, and support employee, customer, and event programs. Company Stores help organizations manage branded products more efficiently across teams and locations.

items.question: Who benefits from a Company Store?
items.answer: Organizations with multiple employees, departments, locations, recurring merchandise needs, event programs, or promotional product initiatives often benefit from a centralized Company Store solution.

cta.label: Learn More About Company Store Benefits

items.question: Can a Company Store require budget approval before an order ships?
items.answer: Yes — this is a separate, optional layer from brand approval. Every product in a Company Store catalog is already pre-approved on the creative side (logos, colors, placements), so no one needs sign-off on how something looks before ordering. What the platform adds on top is an optional spend-approval workflow, so a manager or budget owner can approve a purchase before it's produced, without slowing down the rest of the catalog.

items.question: Can different teams or locations have different pricing or budgets on the same Company Store?
items.answer: Yes. The platform supports multiple price levels and budget controls within a single store, so departments, locations, or employee tiers can see different pricing or spending limits without needing separate stores.

items.question: Can a Company Store issue gift certificates or store credit?
items.answer: Yes. Gift certificates and store credit can be issued through the platform — commonly used for recognition programs, new-hire allowances, or customer incentives — so recipients choose their own items from the approved catalog.

items.question: Can I see reporting and analytics on Company Store orders?
items.answer: Yes. The platform includes reporting tools that track orders, spend, and participation, giving administrators visibility into how a merchandise program is actually being used rather than relying on manual tracking.

items.question: What makes SplashBrands different from other Company Store providers?
items.answer: SplashBrands combines Company Store technology, in-house manufacturing, on-demand production, no inventory requirements, no minimum orders, and integrated merchandising tools within a single platform.

items.question: How does Blossom Rocket work with SplashBrands?
items.answer: Blossom Rocket helps businesses develop the brand systems, merchandise programs, and creative assets that support successful Company Store implementations. SplashBrands provides the platform, production capabilities, and operational infrastructure.
